dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus, visible until the peduncle enters higher turbidity water.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Near-symmetrical lateral margins with a minor localized convex protrusion on the right mid-lateral edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; skin appears largely uniform with very subtle darkening at the anterior neck crease.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient across the dorsal-to-lateral transition.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, small, high-contrast white linear mark located on the posterior segment of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis causing a distinct linear highlight and adjacent shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small white linear scar or pigment loss on the posterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular aperture at the blowhole site with surrounding circular depression.
